verdict.rationale: GitHub documents its pull request workflow for creating and reviewing code, reviewing a diff before creating a PR, and reading and reviewing PRs on mobile and via the CLI. Inline, line-level review comments placed alongside the code are only implied by 'review', and diff comparison is documented mainly in the Copilot agent context. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of inline line-level review comments, first-party docs on comparing diffs between branches in a PR, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can open a pull request, compare diffs, and leave inline review comments alongside the code
